description: This file defines the interface IStorageManager for managing storage related operations within the WPEFramework project. It declares methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage for applications, along with associated parameters and expected behaviors.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface for managing application storage, providing methods to create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specific app ID, returning a storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location, size, and used space for a given app ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specific app ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage data for a specific app ID, including device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears storage data for all apps except those specified in the exemption list.
